svg.aria-label: Do I need Redbelly KYC? Decision guide
svg.text: Find your situation. Read the answer on the right.
Access credential, then enable the account
I run a node and stake
Using the coins needs an enabled wallet
I hold RBNT on an exchange
The exchange has its own KYC rules
I hold wrapped RBNT on another chain
The token lives on that chain, not on Redbelly
I am a holder who wants to stake
Official staking pages cover node operators only
DAO: anyone can join from any region.
Network: not offered in the 18 jurisdictions in clause 15.1 of its terms.
